description: This file defines the AccountEntityServiceFactory class, which manages a collection of AccountEntityService instances mapped by keys. It provides a constructor to initialize the services and a method to retrieve a service by key.

classes.name: AccountEntityServiceFactory
classes.description: A factory class that manages AccountEntityService instances, allowing retrieval by key.

methods.name: AccountEntityServiceFactory
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the map with a set of AccountEntityService instances.

methods.name: getAccountEntityService
methods.description: Returns the AccountEntityService associated with the provided key.
